A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one

<!doctype html>

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 294, false);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.NoToneMapping;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-100, 140, 230, -64, 1, 1500);
ref.name = 'reference-camera';
ref.position.set(0, 0, 540);
ref.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

const grainGLSL = `
  float grainHash(vec2 p) {
    vec3 q = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031);
    q += dot(q, q.yzx + 33.33);
    return fract((q.x + q.y) * q.z);
  }
  vec3 frameGrain(vec2 frag, float amount) {
    vec2 p = floor(frag);
    float alternating = mod(p.x + p.y, 2.0) - 0.5;
    float neutral = (grainHash(p) - 0.5) * 0.78 + alternating * 0.22;
    float tint = grainHash(p + vec2(37.0, 19.0)) - 0.5;
    return amount * (vec3(neutral) + tint * vec3(0.44, -0.10, -0.48));
  }
`;

const backdrop = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    depthWrite: false,
    depthTest: false,
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 screenUV;
      void main() {
        screenUV = uv;
        gl_Position = vec4(position.xy, 0.999, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      varying vec2 screenUV;
      ${grainGLSL}
      void main() {
        float row = (1.0 - screenUV.y) * 294.0;
        float top = pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - row / 111.0), 1.85);
        float bottom = pow(max(0.0, (row - 194.0) / 100.0), 1.52);
        vec3 color = mix(vec3(0.994, 0.994, 0.985),
                         vec3(0.802, 0.805, 0.778), top);
        color = mix(color, vec3(0.666, 0.678, 0.647), bottom);
        float edge = pow(abs(screenUV.x * 2.0 - 1.0), 1.65);
        color -= edge * (0.005 + 0.026 * top + 0.018 * bottom);
        color += frameGrain(gl_FragCoord.xy, 0.020 + 0.023 * (top + bottom));
        gl_FragColor = vec4(clamp(color, 0.0, 1.0), 1.0);
      }
    `
  })
);
backdrop.name = 'seamless-gray-background';
backdrop.frustumCulled = false;
backdrop.renderOrder = -100;
scene.add(backdrop);

scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xfffaf4, 0.86));
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffcf2, 0xbdb7ac, 1.12));

function light(name, color, intensity, x, y, z) {
  const lamp = new THREE.DirectionalLight(color, intensity);
  lamp.name = name;
  lamp.position.set(x, y, z);
  scene.add(lamp);
}

light('upper-left-key', 0xfff8e9, 1.62, -180, 238, 350);
light('front-right-fill', 0xf4f6ff, 0.58, 190, 65, 230);
light('upper-back-fill', 0xfff5dc, 0.84, -95, 190, -250);
light('lower-back-fill', 0xeef3ff, 0.57, 150, -35, -230);

const skin = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  vertexColors: true,
  roughness: 0.96,
  metalness: 0
});

skin.onBeforeCompile = shader => {
  shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader
    .replace('void main() {', `${grainGLSL}\nvoid main() {`)
    .replace('#include <colorspace_fragment>', `
      #include <colorspace_fragment>
      gl_FragColor.rgb = clamp(
        gl_FragColor.rgb + frameGrain(gl_FragCoord.xy, 0.044), 0.0, 1.0
      );
    `);
};

const point = (x, row, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x - 100, 230 - row, z);
const origin = new THREE.Vector3();
const smooth = (low, high, value) => THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(value, low, high);
const clamp = (value, low, high) => Math.max(low, Math.min(high, value));
const square = value => value * value;

function part(parent, name, x, row, z) {
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  const anchor = point(x, row, z);
  group.name = name;
  group.userData.anchor = anchor;
  group.position.copy(anchor).sub(parent.userData.anchor || origin);
  parent.add(group);
  return group;
}

function palette(stops) {
  const colors = stops.map(([row, hex]) => [row, new THREE.Color(hex)]);
  return row => {
    if (row <= colors[0][0]) return colors[0][1].clone();
    for (let i = 1; i < colors.length; i++) {
      const [hi, end] = colors[i];
      if (row <= hi) {
        const [lo, start] = colors[i - 1];
        return start.clone().lerp(end, (row - lo) / (hi - lo));
      }
    }
    return colors[colors.length - 1][1].clone();
  };
}

function profile(keys, row) {
  const last = keys.length - 1;
  if (row <= keys[0][0]) return keys[0].slice(1);
  if (row >= keys[last][0]) return keys[last].slice(1);
  let i = 0;
  while (row > keys[i + 1][0]) i++;
  const a = keys[i];
  const b = keys[i + 1];
  const length = b[0] - a[0];
  const t = (row - a[0]) / length;
  const t2 = t * t;
  const t3 = t2 * t;
  const slope = (j, k) => (keys[j + 1][k] - keys[j][k]) /
    (keys[j + 1][0] - keys[j][0]);
  const tangent = (j, k) => {
    if (j === 0) return slope(0, k);
    if (j === last) return slope(last - 1, k);
    const before = slope(j - 1, k);
    const after = slope(j, k);
    return before * after <= 0 ? 0 : 2 * before * after / (before + after);
  };
  return a.slice(1).map((value, index) => {
    const k = index + 1;
    return (2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) * value
      + (t3 - 2 * t2 + t) * length * tangent(i, k)
      + (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2) * b[k]
      + (t3 - t2) * length * tangent(i + 1, k);
  });
}

function loft(parent, name, first, last, rows, sides, surface, pigment, weights) {
  const positions = [], normals = [], colors = [], indices = [];
  const skinIndices = [], skinWeights = [];
  const stride = sides + 1;
  const anchor = parent.userData.anchor;
  for (let j = 0; j <= rows; j++) {
    const row = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(first, last, j / rows);
    for (let i = 0; i <= sides; i++) {
      const angle = -Math.PI + 2 * Math.PI * i / sides;
      const vertex = surface(row, angle);
      const along = surface(Math.min(last, row + 0.045), angle)
        .sub(surface(Math.max(first, row - 0.045), angle));
      const around = surface(row, angle + 0.003).sub(surface(row, angle - 0.003));
      const normal = along.cross(around);
      if (normal.lengthSq() < 1e-13) normal.set(0, j === 0 ? 1 : -1, 0);
      normal.normalize();

      const color = pigment(row, angle, vertex);
      colors.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
      positions.push(vertex.x - anchor.x, vertex.y - anchor.y, vertex.z - anchor.z);
      normals.push(normal.x, normal.y, normal.z);
      if (weights) {
        const headWeight = weights(row);
        skinIndices.push(0, 1, 0, 0);
        skinWeights.push(1 - headWeight, headWeight, 0, 0);
      }

      if (j < rows && i < sides) {
        const a = j * stride + i;
        const b = a + stride;
        indices.push(a, b, a + 1, a + 1, b, b + 1);
      }
    }
  }

  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geo.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
  geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  let mesh;
  if (weights) {
    geo.setAttribute('skinIndex', new THREE.Uint16BufferAttribute(skinIndices, 4));
    geo.setAttribute('skinWeight', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(skinWeights, 4));
    mesh = new THREE.SkinnedMesh(geo, skin);
    mesh.frustumCulled = false;
  } else {
    mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, skin);
  }
  mesh.name = name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

// Each cross section records the center, width, and front and back depths.
const bodyKeys = [

  [216.0, 98.3, 39.1, 0.3, 23.3, 24.0],
  [224.0, 98.1, 32.4, -0.1, 17.6, 20.3],
  [232.0, 98.0, 23.5, 0.1, 11.3, 14.9],
  [238.0, 97.9, 12.2, 1.2, 5.9, 8.7],
  [241.0, 97.9, 0,    1.8, 0, 0]
];

function ovalFalloff(x, row, cx, cy, rx, ry) {
  return Math.exp(-square((x - cx) / rx) - square((row - cy) / ry));
}

function bodyDepth(row, x, c, mid, front, back) {
  const convex = c * (front + back) * 0.5 + c * c * (front - back) * 0.5;
  let face = 0;
  if (row < 65 && c > 0.3) {
    face = smooth(0.3, 0.86, c) * (
      2.25 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 101.3, 43.9, 5.8, 4.7)
      + 0.77 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 90.7, 45.8, 6.8, 4.6)
      + 0.62 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 111.8, 45.6, 6.5, 4.8)
    );
  }
  return mid + convex + face;
}

function bodySurface(row, angle) {
  const [center, radius, mid, front, back] = profile(bodyKeys, row);
  const x = center + radius * Math.sin(angle);
  return point(x, row, bodyDepth(row, x, Math.cos(angle), mid, front, back));
}

function faceDepth(x, row) {
  const [center, radius, mid, front, back] = profile(bodyKeys, row);
  const sine = clamp((x - center) / radius, -1, 1);
  return bodyDepth(row, x, Math.sqrt(1 - sine * sine), mid, front, back);
}

const peel = palette([
  [17, 0xe1c96d], [30, 0xdec16a], [43, 0xd6b55c], [53, 0xdab254],
  [70, 0xe6be50], [92, 0xecc95b], [113, 0xe7be52], [140, 0xeac050],
  [161, 0xdfb251], [181, 0xd8a64b], [199, 0xd9a347],
  [216, 0xcf963f], [232, 0xc18a3d], [241, 0xae7535]
]);
const belly = palette([
  [91, 0xf3dfa1], [105, 0xf5e3ac], [126, 0xf3e1b6], [145, 0xe9d6b0],
  [158, 0xe3cba5], [172, 0xdcb990], [187, 0xd9ad6d], [206, 0xd3a04c]
]);
const oliveShade = new THREE.Color(0xa18741);
const cheekGold = new THREE.Color(0xe6c474);
const warmShade = new THREE.Color(0x91612c);

function bodyPigment(row, angle, vertex) {
  const x = vertex.x + 100;
  const front = Math.cos(angle);
  const color = peel(row);
  const u = (x - 104 + (row - 132) * 0.045) / 53.0;
  const top = 92 + 32 * u * u + 5 * u;
  const patch = smooth(-4, 16, row - top)
    * (1 - smooth(170, 204, row + 4 * u * u))
    * smooth(0.05, 0.70, front);
  color.lerp(belly(row), patch * 0.99);

  if (row < 66 && front > 0) {
    const shadows =
      0.30 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 86.8, 39.3, 6.3, 4.8)
      + 0.25 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 115.6, 39.4, 5.8, 4.5)
      + 0.16 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 101.2, 50, 11.9, 3.0);
    color.lerp(oliveShade, shadows * smooth(0.25, 0.72, front));
    color.lerp(cheekGold, 0.17 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 102, 43, 8.5, 3.5));
  }
  const low = smooth(214, 240, row);
  color.lerp(warmShade, 0.22 * low * ovalFalloff(x, row, 98, 234, 12, 13));
  return color;
}

const body = loft(torso, 'continuous-head-and-torso-skin', 16.8, 241, 189, 112,
  bodySurface, bodyPigment, row => 1 - smooth(42, 79, row));

function meshFromFace(partGroup, name, positions, colors, indices) {
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, skin);
  mesh.name = name;
  partGroup.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

function faceVertex(group, positions, x, row, offset) {
  const local = point(x, row, faceDepth(x, row) + offset).sub(group.userData.anchor);
  positions.push(local.x, local.y, local.z);
}

function raisedOval(group, name, cx, cy, rx, ry, slant, height, rim, crown) {
  const positions = [], colors = [], indices = [];
  const loops = 7, sides = 32;
  const edge = new THREE.Color(rim), center = new THREE.Color(crown);
  for (let i = 0; i <= loops; i++) {
    const r = i / loops;
    for (let j = 0; j <= sides; j++) {
      const a = j / sides * Math.PI * 2;
      const u = r * Math.cos(a);
      const v = r * Math.sin(a);
      const bump = height * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - r * r), 1.24) - 0.13;
      faceVertex(group, positions, cx + rx * u, cy + ry * v + slant * u, bump);
      const c = edge.clone().lerp(center, (1 - r * r) * (0.86 - v * 0.12));
      colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
      if (i < loops && j < sides) {
        const k = i * (sides + 1) + j;
        const n = k + sides + 1;
        indices.push(k, k + 1, n, k + 1, n + 1, n);
      }
    }
  }
  return meshFromFace(group, name, positions, colors, indices);
}

function faceStroke(group, name, begin, end, centerRow, thickness, offset, hex) {
  const positions = [], colors = [], indices = [];
  const mid = new THREE.Color(hex);
  const edge = mid.clone().lerp(new THREE.Color(0xbe9e56), 0.39);
  const count = 28;
  for (let i = 0; i <= count; i++) {
    const u = 2 * i / count - 1;
    const x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(begin, end, i / count);
    for (let side = -1; side <= 1; side++) {
      const row = centerRow(u) + thickness(u) * side;
      faceVertex(group, positions, x, row, offset(x, row));
      const c = side === 0 ? mid : edge;
      colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
    }
    if (i < count) {
      const a = i * 3;
      indices.push(a, a + 1, a + 3, a + 1, a + 4, a + 3);
      indices.push(a + 1, a + 2, a + 4, a + 2, a + 5, a + 4);
    }
  }
  meshFromFace(group, name, positions, colors, indices);
}

function closedEye(side, x, row, width, slant) {
  const group = part(head, `eye-${side}`, x, row, faceDepth(x, row));
  raisedOval(group, 'soft-upper-lid', x, row, width, 3.25, slant, 1.35,
    0xc5a556, 0xddbe69);
  faceStroke(group, 'closed-lid-crease', x - width * 0.92, x + width * 0.92,
    u => row + 0.39 + 1.94 * (1 - u * u) + slant * u * 0.92,
    u => 0.38 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u), 0.51),
    (px, py) => {
      const u = (px - x) / width;
      const v = (py - row - slant * u) / 3.25;
      return Math.max(0.08, 1.35 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u - v * v), 1.24) - 0.07);
    },
    0x9e874c
  );
}
closedEye('left', 86.8, 37.8, 5.25, 0.26);
closedEye('right', 115.4, 37.9, 4.95, -0.30);

  u => 48.35 + 1.54 * (1 - u * u) - 0.09 * u,
  u => 0.66 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u), 0.46),
  (x, row) => {
    const u = (x - 101.1) / 12.4;
    const v = (row - 50.3 + 0.15 * u) / 1.65;
    return 0.11 + 0.70 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u - v * v), 1.24);
  },
  0x756d42
);

function limb(group, name, keys, pigment, sides = 36, tilt = 0) {
  const first = keys[0][0], last = keys[keys.length - 1][0];
  const surface = (row, angle) => {
    const [x, z, rx, rz] = profile(keys, row);
    let direction = 0;
    if (tilt) {
      const lo = Math.max(first, row - 0.18);
      const hi = Math.min(last, row + 0.18);
      direction = tilt * (profile(keys, hi)[0] - profile(keys, lo)[0]) / (hi - lo);
    }
    const across = rx * Math.sin(angle) / Math.hypot(1, direction);
    return point(x + across, row - across * direction, z + rz * Math.cos(angle));
  };
  return loft(group, name, first, last, Math.max(16, Math.ceil((last - first) * 1.0)),
    sides, surface, pigment);
}
